'''Apple with Mustard and Goat Cheese''' is an eclectic yet easy-to-make appetizer. The unusual flavors and ingredient combinations makes this an excellent way to start a dinner party.

==Ingredients==
*2 Golden Delicious [[Cookbook:Apple|apples]]
*Yellow prepared [[Cookbook:Mustard|mustard]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] crumbly, fresh goat [[Cookbook:cheese|cheese]]
==Procedure==
#Wash the apples and cut across (i.e. not from top to bottom) into slices ¼ inch thick. Preferably the apples should come from the refrigerator as the cold temperature will add to the contrast.
#Spread one side of the apple slices with yellow mustard.
#Crumble the goat cheese onto each slice.
#Serve immediately as is.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
*Golden delicious apples are preferable, but any sweet, crisp apple will do.
*Add honey-roasted nuts of some kind along with the goat cheese for an interesting combination.
*For a professional look, lay each slice of apple on lettuce or another type of garnish.
